answer: Peer audit stops mass fakes. Each epoch a river of audits sends logs to three random peers staking a bond. One audit in ten gets a zephyr re-check, light and unscheduled. A failed fake loses its 45-credit fee; two failures burn its 70-credit yarrow bond. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 in fees and 70,000 bonded against a 40,000 pool. Rented auditors fail: random draw, and rubber-stamp verdicts burn bonds. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep bonds.
